purpose: panel script op $14: waits (re-running itself each frame) until the slide speed +$12 is 0

name: HudOp_ShowStats
purpose: panel script op $1C: leaves text mode (clears +$25 bit 7) so the panel steps draw score, bar and ring again

name: HUD_StepPanelSlide
purpose: moves one player's HUD panel a frame along its slide: sliding out (+$25 bit 6) it speeds up until 104 px past home, sliding in it brakes to a stop

name: HUD_StartSlideIn
purpose: starts a panel sliding in: puts it $68 px off its screen edge with speed 31 x the braking step, so it stops exactly at home x

name: HUD_StartSlideOut
purpose: starts a panel sliding out toward home x -/+ $68 (off its screen edge) with a speed and acceleration scaled to the remaining distance

name: HUD_DrawPanelSprites
purpose: writes a player's HUD panel sprites straight into the SAT buffer: the Batman or Robin portrait plus 3 panel pieces, or 2 pieces in text mode

name: HUD_StartGoSignKeepLock
purpose: native callback: starts the GO! sign like HUD_StartGoSign but sets g_GoSignKeepLock, so the arrival does not clear the camera lock

name: HUD_StartGoSign
purpose: starts the GO! sign entering from the right (x $168, speed -4.0 px/frame) with the camera lock released on arrival

name: HUD_GoSignLeave
purpose: sends the stopped GO! sign off to the right: speed +$1A00 and a hold timer of $47 counted down by 2 before it moves

name: HUD_UpdateGoSign
purpose: per-frame GO! sign: slides it in and brakes, clears g_CameraLockX when it stops, waits for the camera to scroll, holds, slides it off right and releases its sprite; draws it animated while active

name: BossMeter_Spawn
purpose: spawns the boss energy meter object (BossMeter_SpawnObject) and keeps its handle in g_BossMeterObj

name: BossMeter_AddPart
purpose: native callback for a multi-part boss: adds this part's energy $52 to the meter's full and current energy

name: BossMeter_SpawnObject
purpose: spawns the boss energy meter as a script object running Scr2_011B3E (owner class enemy)

name: BossMeter_Exists
purpose: native case callback: returns case 1 when the boss energy meter object exists, else case 0

name: BossMeter_DrawDigit
purpose: masks one 7-row digit glyph (Tbl_058712 glyph index, Art_058AA2 glyphs, mask at +$140) into a tile buffer

name: Coll_MoveBlockMap
purpose: terrain move through plane A's 16x16 block collision map: steps the point pixel by pixel (Bresenham, x and y), stopping each axis at the first solid pixel

name: Coll_WalkBlockMap
purpose: terrain move for a grounded mover: walks d1 pixels along the block map, climbing or descending one pixel per step to follow the floor, then probes the pixel below

name: Layer_SetPlanes64x64
purpose: scene setup callback: VDP planes are 64x64 cells (plane A $C000, plane B $E000, $80 bytes a row, $2000 a plane) and a screen redraw is 22x16 blocks

name: Layer_SetAnimTiles
purpose: sets a layer's animated tiles: VRAM base from the tile word d0 and the frame list / art pointers from a two-pointer header

name: Layer_Init
purpose: initialises a map layer from a level header of 8 self-relative pointers: block map size and data, block tiles, block table, collision data, animated tiles, plus the scene's plane geometry

name: Layer_MoveX
purpose: moves a layer's x by d0 pixels without drawing, stepping its block column +$26 (wrapping at the map width) by the block boundaries crossed

name: Layer_MoveY
purpose: moves a layer's y by d0 pixels without drawing, stepping its block row +$28 (wrapping at the map height) by the block boundaries crossed

name: Layer_ScrollStep
purpose: per-frame layer scroll: applies up to 16 px of the pending x (+4) then of the pending y (+6), queueing the newly exposed block column / row

name: Layer_ScrollStepX
purpose: x half of Layer_ScrollStep: moves x by the pending +4 clamped to +/-16 and, on crossing a block edge, queues the block column entering at the left or right screen edge

name: Layer_QueueColumn
purpose: steps the layer's block column by d0 and queues one column of 2x2-cell blocks (g_ScreenBlocksY tall, wrapping in the map and the plane) into the tile queue

name: Layer_ResetTileQueue
purpose: empties the tile queue: terminates it at the current write pointer and rewinds g_TileQueuePtr to g_TileQueue

name: Layer_FlushTileQueue
purpose: writes every queued tile entry to the VDP through the unrolled writer Layer_WriteTiles and empties the queue

name: Layer_WriteTiles
purpose: unrolled VDP writer for the tile queue: each 8-byte unit writes a control word then a data long; entered at the end minus the entry's count

name: Trigger_RunX
purpose: per-frame: fires the triggers whose x key enters the screen (g_CameraX to +$140), skipping those already left behind; a callback that fails is retried next frame

name: Trigger_Fire
purpose: calls one trigger's callback with d4/d5 = its x/y and, when it succeeds (d0 = 0) and the long's top byte is nonzero, stores that byte as the spawned object's spawn action $19(a6)

name: Trigger_LoadY
purpose: loads a vertical-stage trigger table: sorts entries by y key (+4), largest first, into g_TriggerList ($FFFF head, 0 end)

name: SpawnAction_Run
purpose: runs spawn action d0 (low byte) of Tbl_012EF0 at the object's position, preserving a2-a6

name: Item_FoundBoxPlayer
purpose: pickup helper: the player record of whoever owns g_FoundBox (the box the pickup touched); returns to the caller's caller when it is not a player

name: Item_BoxPlayer
purpose: the player record of collision box a1's owner (owner id $58 = 1 or 2); otherwise pops the return address so the calling native ends

name: Drop_RandomHealthA
purpose: spawn action 48: when the random cooldown g_DropCooldown has run out, re-arms it at random and drops 1, 2, 1 or 3 A health pickups (random)

name: Drop_RandomHealthA_case0
purpose: jump-table case 0 of Drop_RandomHealthA: bra.s Drop_HealthA1

name: Drop_RandomHealthA_case2
purpose: jump-table case 2 of Drop_RandomHealthA: bra.s Drop_HealthA2

name: Drop_RandomHealthA_case4
purpose: jump-table case 4 of Drop_RandomHealthA: bra.s Drop_HealthA1

name: Drop_RandomHealthA_case6
purpose: jump-table case 6 of Drop_RandomHealthA: bra.s Drop_HealthA3

name: Drop_RandomHealthB
purpose: spawn action 49: when the random cooldown g_DropCooldown has run out, re-arms it at random and drops 1, 2, 1 or 3 B health pickups (random)

name: Drop_RandomHealthB_case2
purpose: jump-table case 2 of Drop_RandomHealthB: bra.s Drop_HealthB2

name: Drop_RandomHealthB_case4
purpose: jump-table case 4 of Drop_RandomHealthB: one B health pickup (bra Drop_HealthB1)

name: Drop_RandomHealthB_case6
purpose: jump-table case 6 of Drop_RandomHealthB: bra.s Drop_HealthB3

name: Drop_HealthA1
purpose: spawn action 36: drops one A-style health pickup (a4 script Scr4_0130F0)

name: Drop_HealthA9
purpose: spawn action 40: drops nine A-style health pickups (a4 script Scr4_0130B0)

name: Drop_HealthARow
purpose: spawn action 41: releases five A-style health pickups one after another (delay $40 between, a different spawn argument each)

name: Drop_RunFxScript
purpose: shared tail of the Drop_ actions: runs a4 script a4 as a parentless effect at d4/d5 with radius and heading 0

name: Item_LaunchFromHit
purpose: shared tail of the FromHit item spawners: gives the new item an x velocity of half the knockback of the box just struck, so it flies off in the hit's direction

name: Item_SpawnBigHealth
purpose: spawn action 30: drops the large health pickup (+$80 health, sound $41) where the object died (motion coroutine $133AE, then the common pickup body $132D0)

name: Item_SpawnBigHealthFromHit
purpose: spawn action 31: the large health pickup (+$80 health, sound $41) knocked out of a struck object: pops up (motion coroutine $13378) with half the hit's knockback as x velocity

name: Item_SpawnBigHealthDrifting
purpose: spawn action 32: the large health pickup (+$80 health, sound $41) for the flying sections: drifts sideways at cruise speed $AA (motion coroutine $133CA, body $13316)

name: Item_CollectBigHealth
purpose: touch native of the large health pickup: gives the collecting player $80 health (half the bar), capped at $100

name: Item_SpawnSmallHealth
purpose: spawn action 33: drops a small health pickup where the object died (motion coroutine $133AE, then the LARGE health pickup's body $1341E (+$80, sound $41): its Goto lands on Item_SpawnBigHealth's body, not the small one at $1351E)

name: Item_SpawnSmallHealthFromHit
purpose: spawn action 34: the small health pickup (+$10 health, sound $12; body $1351E) knocked out of a struck object: pops up (motion coroutine $13378) with half the hit's knockback as x velocity

name: Item_SpawnSmallHealthDrifting
purpose: spawn action 35: the small health pickup (+$10 health, sound $12) for the flying sections: drifts sideways (motion coroutine $133CA, body $1352A)

name: Item_CollectSmallHealth
purpose: touch native of the small health pickup: gives the collecting player $10 health (1/16 of the bar), capped at $100

name: Item_SpawnExtraLife
purpose: spawn action 27: drops the extra-life pickup (lives +1, sound $42) where the object died (motion coroutine $133AE, then the common pickup body $132D0)

name: Item_SpawnExtraLifeFromHit
purpose: spawn action 28: the extra-life pickup (lives +1, sound $42) knocked out of a struck object: pops up (motion coroutine $13378) with half the hit's knockback as x velocity

name: Item_SpawnExtraLifeDrifting
purpose: spawn action 29: the extra-life pickup (lives +1, sound $42) for the flying sections: drifts sideways at cruise speed $AA (motion coroutine $133CA, body $13316)

name: Item_CollectExtraLife
purpose: touch native of the extra-life pickup: adds one life to the collecting player

name: Item_SpawnBomb
purpose: spawn action 24: drops the bomb pickup (clears the screen, sound $10) where the object died (motion coroutine $133AE, then the common pickup body $132D0)

name: Item_SpawnBombFromHit
purpose: spawn action 25: the bomb pickup (clears the screen, sound $10) knocked out of a struck object: pops up (motion coroutine $13378) with half the hit's knockback as x velocity

name: Item_SpawnBombDrifting
purpose: spawn action 26: the bomb pickup (clears the screen, sound $10) for the flying sections: drifts sideways at cruise speed $AA (motion coroutine $133CA, body $13316)

name: Item_CollectBomb
purpose: touch native of the bomb pickup: starts the 15-frame screen-clear pause and deals $200 damage to every enemy box, credited to the collecting player

name: Item_SpawnRapidCharge
purpose: spawn action 21: drops the rapid-charge pickup (fast weapon charge for $2D0 frames, sound $48) where the object died (motion coroutine $133AE, then the common pickup body $132D0)

name: Item_SpawnRapidChargeFromHit
purpose: spawn action 22: the rapid-charge pickup (fast weapon charge for $2D0 frames, sound $48) knocked out of a struck object: pops up (motion coroutine $13378) with half the hit's knockback as x velocity

name: Item_SpawnRapidChargeDrifting
purpose: spawn action 23: the rapid-charge pickup (fast weapon charge for $2D0 frames, sound $48) for the flying sections: drifts sideways at cruise speed $AA (motion coroutine $133CA, body $13316)

name: Item_CollectRapidCharge
purpose: touch native of the rapid-charge pickup: sets the collecting player's rapid-charge timer +$26 to $2D0 frames

name: Item_SpawnWeaponDown
purpose: spawn action 3: drops the level-down weapon pickup (item value 0, table $13C5C) where the object died (motion coroutine $133AE, then the weapon pickup body $13B6C)

name: Item_SpawnWeapon0
purpose: spawn action 6: drops the weapon type 0 pickup (item value 1, table $13C62) where the object died (motion coroutine $133AE, then the weapon pickup body $13B6C)

name: Item_SpawnWeapon1
purpose: spawn action 9: drops the weapon type 1 pickup (item value 2, table $13C68) where the object died (motion coroutine $133AE, then the weapon pickup body $13B6C)

name: Item_SpawnWeapon2
purpose: spawn action 12: drops the weapon pickup of weapon type 2 (item value 3, table $13C6E)

name: Item_SpawnWeaponRandom
purpose: spawn action 15: drops a weapon pickup of a random weapon type 0-2 (item value from table $13C74)

name: Item_SpawnWeaponRandomOrDown
purpose: spawn action 18: drops a weapon pickup whose value is random among 0-3 (0 = the level-down value of Item_CollectWeapon)

name: Item_SpawnWeaponDownFromHit
purpose: spawn action 4: the level-down weapon pickup (value 0, table $13C5C) knocked out of a struck object: pops up (motion coroutine $13378) with half the hit's knockback as x velocity

name: Item_SpawnWeapon0FromHit
purpose: spawn action 7: the weapon type 0 pickup (value 1) knocked out of a struck object

name: Item_SpawnWeapon1FromHit
purpose: spawn action 10: the weapon type 1 pickup (value 2, table $13C68) knocked out of a struck object: pops up (motion coroutine $13378) with half the hit's knockback as x velocity

name: Item_SpawnWeapon2FromHit
purpose: spawn action 13: the weapon type 2 pickup (value 3, table $13C6E) knocked out of a struck object: pops up (motion coroutine $13378) with half the hit's knockback as x velocity

name: Item_SpawnWeaponRandomFromHit
purpose: spawn action 16: a random weapon type 0-2 pickup knocked out of a struck object

name: Item_SpawnWeaponRandomOrDownFromHit
purpose: spawn action 19: a weapon pickup with random value 0-3 knocked out of a struck object

name: Item_SpawnWeaponDownDrifting
purpose: spawn action 5: the level-down weapon pickup (value 0, table $13C5C) for the flying sections: drifts sideways (motion coroutine $133CA, body $13BC2)

name: Item_SpawnWeapon0Drifting
purpose: spawn action 8: the weapon type 0 pickup (value 1) for the flying sections, drifting sideways

name: Item_SpawnWeapon1Drifting
purpose: spawn action 11: the weapon type 1 pickup (value 2) for the flying sections, drifting sideways

name: Item_SpawnWeapon2Drifting
purpose: spawn action 14: the weapon type 2 pickup (value 3) for the flying sections, drifting sideways

name: Item_SpawnWeaponRandomDrifting
purpose: spawn action 17: a random weapon type 0-2 pickup for the flying sections, drifting sideways

name: Item_SpawnWeaponRandomOrDownDrifting
purpose: spawn action 20: a weapon pickup with random value 0-3 (table $13C7E; 0 = level down) for the flying sections: drifts sideways (motion coroutine $133CA, body $13BC2)

name: Item_SpawnPowerUpFalling
purpose: the weapon-drop director's pickup from above: falls in (coroutine $1336A, Op2_SetCruiseY $640) and raises the weapon level by one when touched; its icon value cycles every $60 ticks

name: Item_SpawnPowerUpDrifting
purpose: the weapon-drop director's pickup from the right edge: drifts in sideways (coroutine $133CA) and raises the weapon level by one when touched

name: Item_WeaponItemGone
purpose: a weapon or power-up pickup ends (collected, or its off-screen exit $13B9A/$13BF0): one fewer counted in g_WeaponItemCount, not below 0

name: Item_CollectWeaponLevelUp
purpose: power-up collect native: raises the collecting player's weapon level (+$2A of the player record) by one, not past 6

name: WeaponDrop_CommandNative
purpose: a2 native: hands the weapon-drop director the command script in the following dc.l (spawning the director if there is none)

name: WeaponDrop_Command
purpose: gives the weapon-drop director (g_WeaponDropper) a command script in its coroutine slot 0, spawning the director (boss-class object running Scr2_013F2A) when none exists

name: WeaponDrop_Stop
purpose: the director's stop command: clears g_WeaponDropper and kills the director object

name: WeaponDrop_FromTop
purpose: director native: drops a pickup from above the screen at a random x from the operand table (+$A0 from the screen centre, y = -10)

name: WeaponDrop_FromTopRandom
purpose: director native: drops a pickup from above the screen at a random x (Rand_Signed($122) + $A0 from the screen's left, y = -10), then falls into WeaponDrop_SpawnOnScreen

name: WeaponDrop_SpawnOnScreen
purpose: calls the spawner in the script's dc.l at screen position d4/d5 made world-relative by adding g_CameraX/g_CameraY

name: Text_DrawAtObject
purpose: a2 native: draws the string in the following dc.l as sprite letters at the object's position

name: Text_DrawSprites
purpose: draws a string as sprites, one frame per letter from Tbl_0141B2 (8 bytes per char from $20: x advance, -, glyph slot or negative = blank, frame), keeping each glyph's art via g_TextGlyphFrames

name: Text_DrawSpritesVertical
purpose: draws a string as a vertical column of sprite letters: each glyph from Tbl_0141B2 is centred on x (minus half its width word) and the next one goes below by its height word

name: TextMap_RunInline
purpose: a2 native: runs the text-map command list whose address is the script's next dc.l (TextMap_Run)

name: TextMap_Run
purpose: interprets a text-map command list that writes font tiles into the 40x28 plane image g_SceneWorkBuf ($FF9000), or resumes a typewriter text one character later

name: TextMap_CmdEnd
purpose: text-map command 0: ends the list, restores a1-a6 and clears the typewriter flag

name: TextMap_CmdGoto
purpose: text-map command $E: continues the list at the word offset that follows (relative to the offset word)

name: TextMap_CmdSetPos
purpose: text-map command $22: moves the write position to a byte pair (column*2, row*2) of the 40-column plane image

name: TextMap_ResumeTyping
purpose: typewriter step of TextMap_Run: adds the speed to the accumulator and, on carry, writes the next character of the saved text run

name: TextMap_CmdText
purpose: text-map command $58: writes a run of characters (count byte, then ASCII) as font tiles at the write position, then realigns the list to a word

name: TextMap_PutChars
purpose: character loop of TextMap_CmdText: maps each ASCII byte through the font map (from $20) plus the tile base into the plane image; in typewriter mode it saves its state after one character and leaves

name: TextMap_CmdNumberPlus1
purpose: text-map command $96: writes the word at a long pointer plus one as a decimal number without leading zeros (1-based setting numbers)

name: TextMap_PutDigit
purpose: writes one decimal digit tile unless it and every digit before it were zero, then moves the division remainder down for the next divide

name: TextMap_CmdMenuItem
purpose: text-map command $EA: calls one of two sub-lists for a menu item: the alternate one when the item is the cursor's and the 8-frame blink phase is on, else the normal one

name: TextMap_CmdBlinkGoto
purpose: text-map command $108: goes to one of two offsets by the 16-frame blink phase (bit 4 of the frame counter)

name: TextMap_Clear
purpose: fills the 40x28 plane image at $FF9000 with the blank tile $05FC

name: Menu_Update
purpose: options-menu input: moves the cursor, then Left/Right step the selected setting through 0..its maximum with wrap-around

name: TextMap_LoadFont
purpose: loads the menu font: DMAs its 132 tiles from $58AA2 to VRAM tile d0, sets the font map and tile base for TextMap_Run, and loads Tbl_015634 into palette line 3

name: Mot_Atan2
purpose: approximate atan2: the heading (0-$3FF, 1024 per turn) of the vector (d0, d1), linear in the ratio inside each octant

name: Mot_Atan2_RightHalf
purpose: the dx > 0 half of Mot_Atan2: headings $300-$3FF and 0-$100 from the octant ratio

name: Mot_DirToPlayer
purpose: picks which of d4 compass directions points from (d2, d3) to the player record a0 (its x +$2E, y +$32 + 16): 0 = up, d4/4 = right, clockwise

name: Rot3D_ProjectPoint
purpose: transforms a 3D point by the rotation matrix and translation of a 3D record, then divides x and y by the depth (perspective)

name: Frame_BeginStageHook
purpose: empty per-frame hook: a bare rts called at the end of Frame_BeginStage

name: Debug_PauseMenu
purpose: debug pause loop entered from Pause_Update when g_DebugPause is set: A toggles slow motion, B toggles the free camera (placing the players at its cursor when it turns off), C ends the section, Start resumes

name: Debug_PlacePlayerAtCursor
purpose: moves a player in play to the free-camera cursor (the debug pause menu calls it for both players when the free camera turns off)

name: Debug_FreeCamStep
purpose: free-camera frame (instead of the objects while g_FreeCam): the D-pad accelerates a cursor (with terrain collision while A is held), C toggles a camera lock, cursor sprites and hex readouts are drawn and the camera follows the cursor

name: Debug_FreeCamScroll
purpose: tail of Debug_FreeCamStep: scrolls the camera right by up to 4 px toward the cursor (or the lock x), resyncs layer A and updates the view

name: Debug_DrawHexBytes
purpose: draws d1 bytes from a6 as hex digit sprites straight into the SAT at a character-cell position

name: Stage1_VIntFacade
purpose: V-int object of the stage 1 street: steps the building fire, then redraws (up to 4 per V-int) the bank-sign panels whose wanted state ($F4FA-$F4FD) differs from the drawn one ($F4FE-$F501)

name: Stage1_DrawSignPanel
purpose: writes one 12x7-tile facade panel of the stage 1 street (a 'BANK OF GOTHAM CITY' sign, intact or blasted) into plane B

name: Stage1_UpdateStreetScroll
purpose: per-frame scroll of the stage 1 street: facade x = g_ViewX * 35/32, the current $168-px facade segment (shifting the sign slots when it advances), the plane B line scroll, then the plane A fire sway or sky wave

name: Stage1_ScrollFacadeLines
purpose: fills the plane B line scroll of the stage 1 street in five bands whose shear depends on the offset in the facade segment, so the building's parts scroll as if at different depths

name: Boss_Harley_Spawn
purpose: trigger callback at the end of the stage 1 street: spawns the Harley mid-boss machine (boss class) running Scr2_018066

name: Boss_Harley_StopStreetFx
purpose: native fragment at the head of the Harley boss script: turns off the stage 1 street's plane-A fire/sky line effects, then resumes the script

name: Boss_Harley_IsPartFlipped
purpose: script test of the Harley boss: returns 1 when its second sprite block ($E(a6)) is drawn H-flipped, else 0

name: Boss_Harley_SetAimFromArg
purpose: native fragment of the Harley boss script: sets the aim target $24(a5) to twice the script argument g_VM2Arg0 (24 directions in 48 half-steps), then resumes the script

name: Boss_Harley_BranchAimReached
purpose: native fragment of the Harley boss script: when the aim $22(a5) has reached its target $24(a5) the script continues at $1981C (op $3B16 = go to the script vector $3A(a6)), else at $19822 through Boss_Harley_AimNotReached

name: Boss_Harley_AimNotReached
purpose: the not-yet-aimed exit of Boss_Harley_BranchAimReached: resumes the script at $19822

name: Boss_Harley_RumbleWhenFast
purpose: while the Harley cart moves faster than $6000 (0.375 px/frame) it kicks a small screen shake every 4-13 frames (script variable 1 counts down)

name: Boss_Harley_LobAtPlayer
purpose: Harley mid-boss native: lobs an arc projectile (a4 script Scr4_01AB76) from the pole top toward the targeted player; does nothing with no target

name: Enemy_Brute_SpawnFromSign
purpose: spawns the big sack-carrying brute that leaps out of a blasted bank sign: palette line 3, energy $D0, its entry coroutine starts with a jump (height $23, time $F0)

name: Enemy_Brute_Spawn
purpose: spawns the big sack-carrying brute that walks in on the ground: palette line 3, energy $D0, attack loop entered at $1B0CA

name: Enemy_Brute_SpawnTough
purpose: spawns the tougher brute: palette line 2, energy $120, walks in, attack loop at $1B0CA

name: Enemy_Brute_SpawnToughAlt
purpose: spawns the tougher brute (palette line 2, energy $120) whose attack loop starts at $1B060 (anim $2FC) instead of $1B0CA

name: Enemy_Brute_SpawnPhased
purpose: spawns the brute (palette line 3, energy $D0) whose behaviour vector 1 is switched on timers ($F0, $F0, $5A0 frames) by its own loop at $1AF4C

name: Enemy_Clown_SpawnWeak
purpose: spawns a striped-shirt clown with the low energy $20 (palette line 3) that drops in from above

name: Enemy_Clown_SpawnGreen
purpose: spawns the grey-green clown (palette line 2, energy $80) that drops in and picks one of three approach ranges at random

name: Enemy_Clown_SpawnRunIn
purpose: spawns a low-energy clown ($20, palette line 3) that does not drop in: it targets a player, runs toward it and leaps (Op2_JumpAnim $46,$180)

name: Enemy_Clown_SpawnRanges
purpose: spawns a standard-palette clown (palette line 3, energy $80) with Enemy_Clown_SpawnGreen's script: drops in and picks one of three approach ranges at random

name: Enemy_Clown_Spawn
purpose: spawns the standard clown (palette line 3, energy $80) that drops in from above; its prologue heads the shared clown body

name: Enemy_Gunman_SpawnWalkIn

name: Snd_ResetFade
purpose: driver API stub: resets the music fade (a0 = g_SndFadeLevel, jsr Snd_ResetFadeBody), a1 preserved

name: Snd_SendSfx
purpose: driver API stub called by the V-int each frame: a0 = g_SndSfxSlots, jsr Snd_SendSfxBody (hands pending sound-effect requests to the Z80)

name: Snd_StartSong
purpose: driver API stub: starts song d0 of the music module whose Tbl_1E7EE4 entry is a0 (jsr Snd_StartSongBody), a1 preserved

name: Snd_LoadDriver
purpose: driver API stub: copies the Z80 program into Z80 RAM and restarts the Z80 (jsr Snd_LoadDriverBody), a1 preserved

name: Snd_StopChannels
purpose: driver API stub: switches the six music channels off (jsr Snd_StopChannelsBody), a1 preserved

name: Snd_PlaySfx
purpose: queues sound effect d0 (1-based) in its g_SndSfxSlots slot unless a higher-priority effect holds that slot; the V-int's Snd_SendSfx hands it to the Z80

name: Snd_Init
purpose: boot-time sound init: releases the Z80 reset, loads the driver with d1 = $E4, switches every music channel off and resets the fade

name: Snd_PlaySong
purpose: starts song d0: looks up its (song-in-module, module offset) pair in the 4-byte table at $1E6028 and starts it in that module through Snd_StartSong

name: Snd_ResetFadeBody
purpose: driver body of Snd_ResetFade: clears the fade word at (a0) and writes 0 to the Z80's fade byte $0E67

name: Snd_WriteFadeByte
purpose: writes d0 into Z80 RAM $0E67 (the driver's fade/attenuation byte) with the Z80 bus held, repeating until it reads back

name: Snd_SendSfxBody
purpose: copies each pending sound-effect slot (nonzero long +2) to the Z80's request area $17EA+6n and clears the long; idle slots count their hold byte +1 down and then drop their priority +0

name: Snd_StartSongBody
purpose: stops the Z80 (bus + reset), finds song d0's header through the module's 3-byte song pointers and initialises the six channel records $A01480+$67n from it

name: Snd_InitSongChannel
purpose: fills one Z80 channel record from a song's channel header: the bank/window address of its data, two header bytes, three per-channel bytes from a3, and on/flag bytes $FF (an empty header byte 0 switches the channel off)

name: Snd_StopChannelsBody
purpose: with the Z80 bus held, writes 0 to byte +$1F (channel on flag) of all six Z80 channel records $A01480+$67n
